summary_ja: 自己資本比率規制金融機関が発行し適格資産要件・開示要件を満たすカバード・ボンドのリスク・ウェイトを、個別格付又は発行体のリスク・ウェイトに応じて定め、適格資産・開示・カバード・ボンドの要件を定義する。
summary_en: Risk weights for covered bonds issued by regulated financial institutions that meet eligible-asset and disclosure requirements — by the bond's own rating, or else by the issuer's risk weight — and the definitions of those requirements.

terms.ja: カバード・ボンド発行体

paragraphs: The risk weight of exposures to covered bonds (meaning exposures to covered bonds issued by capital-regulated financial institutions that satisfy the eligible asset requirements and the disclosure requirements; the same applies in the following paragraph) shall be as set out in the left column of the following table, according to the credit risk category corresponding to the issue-specific rating assigned to the exposure to covered bonds. {{T:p70t0}}

The risk weight of exposures to covered bonds without an issue-specific rating shall be as set out in the left column of the following table, according to the risk weight of the capital-regulated financial institution that is the issuer of the exposure to covered bonds (referred to as the "covered bond issuer" in this Article). In this case, the risk weight of the covered bond issuer referred to shall be a value reflecting the results of the due diligence analysis provided in paragraph (4) of the preceding Article. {{T:p70t1}}

The "eligible asset requirements" in paragraph (1) means satisfying all of the following requirements. (i) That the assets included in the cover pool (meaning the pool of underlying assets of covered bonds; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) satisfy any of the following requirements; provided, however, that this does not prevent the covered bond issuer from including in the cover pool substitute assets (meaning cash or short-term, highly liquid assets held in place of assets in the cover pool, added in preparation for impairment of those assets) or derivative transactions to hedge the risk of impairment of the assets in the cover pool. (a) Loans, bonds or other claims on central governments, central banks, the Bank for International Settlements, the International Monetary Fund, the European Central Bank, the European Union, the European Stability Mechanism, the European Financial Stability Facility, multilateral development banks, local governments in Japan, the Japan Finance Organization for Municipalities, Japanese government-affiliated agencies and public sector entities other than foreign central governments, etc. (referred to as "loans, etc." in this item), or loans, etc. guaranteed by them. (b) Loans, etc. secured by real estate for residential use subject to sound underwriting and preservation requirements (meaning real estate that is a residential facility and is valid in light of the laws and regulations (including foreign laws and regulations) for using that real estate as a residence; the same applies in (c) and in Article 37-4, paragraph (1), item (i)), whose loan-to-value (meaning the value obtained by dividing the amount of the loans, etc. by the value of the property pledged as collateral; the same applies in (c)) is 80% or less. (c) Loans, etc. secured by real estate other than real estate for residential use subject to sound underwriting and preservation requirements, whose loan-to-value is 60% or less. (d) Loans, etc. to capital-regulated financial institutions to which a risk weight of 30% or less applies under paragraph (1) or paragraph (8) of the preceding Article, or loans, etc. guaranteed by such capital-regulated financial institutions, where the ratio of the amount of these loans, etc. to the price of the covered bonds at issuance does not exceed 15%. (ii) That the ratio of the nominal amount of the cover pool that the covered bond issuer allocates to the covered bonds (meaning the total amount of loans, etc. included in the cover pool; the same applies in item (i)(a) of the following paragraph) to the outstanding balance of those covered bonds is not less than 110% (where there is no legal framework regulating that ratio, including that the covered bond issuer regularly discloses that the ratio is not less than 110%). (iii) That the requirements listed in the preceding two items are satisfied throughout the period from the creation of the covered bonds to their maturity.

The "disclosure requirements" in paragraph (1) means that the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has arrangements in place so that it can submit all of the following matters at the request of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency. (i) The following information relating to the covered bonds: (a) The nominal amount of the cover pool and the outstanding balance of the covered bonds. (b) The types and geographical distribution of the assets included in the cover pool, and the number of loans, etc. included in the cover pool. (c) The interest rate and foreign exchange risks that may arise for the covered bond issuer from issuing the covered bonds. (d) The maturity of the assets making up the cover pool and of the covered bonds. (e) The proportion of loans in the cover pool that are more than 90 days or three months or more past due. (ii) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach receives the information listed in (a) through (e) of the preceding item from the issuer at least once every six months.

In paragraph (1), where, as a result of the due diligence analysis by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach, the credit standing of covered bonds is assessed as carrying higher risk than the credit standing indicated by the credit risk category corresponding to the issue-specific rating assigned to those covered bonds, the risk weight corresponding to a credit risk category one or more grades lower than the credit risk category corresponding to that issue-specific rating shall be used; provided, however, that a risk weight corresponding to a credit risk category higher than the credit risk category corresponding to that issue-specific rating shall not be used.

The "covered bond" in paragraph (1) and the preceding three paragraphs means a bond that satisfies all of the following requirements. (i) That, under laws and regulations (including foreign laws and regulations), it is subject to supervision by a central government, a central bank, etc. or a public sector entity other than a central government, in order to protect its holders. (ii) That, under laws and regulations (including foreign laws and regulations), its issuance proceeds are required to be invested in assets that satisfy all of the following requirements: (a) That, while the bond remains in existence, they can cover the claims attached to it. (b) That, if the issuer of the bond defaults, they can be used to repay the principal and interest of the bond on a priority basis.
